title: Alternate suit 3: Don Cherry multicoloured madras plaid

clothingReference.description: Don Cherry's actual multicoloured plaid suit and blue speckled tie with a yellow-orange-red centre band
clothingReference.author: SI Staff
clothingReference.adaptation: Plaid fabric, palette and tie adapted onto the established robot jacket cut. Human anatomy, double-breasted construction, boutonniere and handheld microphone were not copied. Photograph is local research only and is not distributed with the artwork.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create ONE transparent PNG production character cutout on the full untrimmed 1254 x 1254 square canvas.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the original Don robot default pose. Input 2 is a REAL CLOTHING REFERENCE: Don Cherry on the left wearing his multicoloured plaid suit, photographed May 28, 2008. Change ONLY the robot's jacket fabric and tie to closely adapt this actual outfit.
Match the photographed fabric: vivid woven madras plaid made from intersecting broad straight horizontal and vertical bands in orange, red-orange, golden yellow, aqua/turquoise blue, muted green and lavender-purple, producing regular medium-size square checks. Approximately 7 to 9 checks across the torso width. Broad colored bands with subtle woven overlap, NOT diagonal argyle, not a rainbow gradient, not patchwork, no flowers or paisley, no thin black tartan grid. Follow the plaid across lapels and sleeves naturally.
Match the photographed tie: blue/teal silk with tiny pale speckles and a broad glowing yellow-orange-red horizontal band across the lower middle, like the abstract sunset in the actual photo. Keep the robot's white shirt and cuffs, white pocket square, jacket cut/lapels and small black lapel microphone. Do not add the photo's boutonniere, handheld microphone, double-breasted buttons or extra accessories.
Preserve every other part of input 1: silver faceted robot face, cyan screen eyes, sculpted white metallic hair, connected white moustache and broad goatee, closed mouth seam, gaze and stern expression, hands/fingers clasped low, head and shoulder anchors, body silhouette, scale, square margins and lower cutoff. Same polished detailed cel-shaded illustration, sharp black outlines and silver shading. Left host facing slightly screen-right, never mirror.
True transparent alpha background including gaps. No desk, chair, scenery, floor, cast shadow, text, watermark or additional characters. This is Alternate suit 3, a nonholiday wardrobe. One pose only.
assets.postprocessing: Original generated PNG preserved byte-for-byte. WebP quality 94 at 1254 and 640 pixels. AVIF uses the existing coachs:assets recipe.
